discovery: Theoretical prediction and experimental discovery of topological insulators (the quantum spin Hall effect)
rationale: Topological insulators are a mature, highly cited condensed-matter breakthrough. They pair a clean theory step (the Kane-Mele Z2 topological invariant and quantum spin Hall prediction, 2005) with a decisive experiment (Molenkamp's HgTe quantum well observation, 2007). They have long ranked high in Nobel forecasts, already hold the Breakthrough, Dirac and Oliver Buckley prizes, and build on the 2016 topology prize without repeating the 2024-2025 themes of neural networks and superconducting quantum circuits.
